I live locally to this pet shop and have visited several times over the years. I first came into contact with them when my son accidentally broke my previous fish tank and it started leaking. I rushed to the shop and purchased a new 64-litre tank, which I have now had for around three years.

The tank has been excellent and looks great. It keeps my goldfish happy and healthy, and the filter has worked very well throughout this time.

I regularly visit the shop to buy fish food, water treatment chemicals and other supplies. The staff are always friendly, helpful and welcoming. Even the security guard is very friendly and polite.

I have had a very positive experience with this pet shop and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a good local pet shop

The expert that came to speak to us about the fish was more concerned with selling us a big tank rather than sharing knowledge about the type of fish we should be getting and info on balancing the tank.

We took 3 fish from this store who died within 48 hours then another 3 and they died within one week. All lethargic, all not swimming and just sitting at the bottom of the tank. This shop sells sick fish. Beware.

We went to Supreme Animal Foods pet, reptile and aquatic store in Lewisham who tested our water, shared knowledge and advised us well. We took 3 fish from here and they are amazing.

Absolutely appalling service from Pets at Home Old Kent Road.
My dogs eat raw food, so I went into the store on Sunday looking for duck wings, duck necks and other basic raw food items. They didn’t have what I needed, so I asked when the delivery was due. I was told Monday.
I went back Monday — still nothing. I was then told to come back Tuesday. Tuesday came — still nothing. I was told Wednesday. Rather than waste yet another journey today, I called the store, only to be told, yet again, to try Thursday.
This is beyond frustrating. How can customers possibly rely on Pets at Home when you can’t even keep basic raw food products in stock, and nobody seems to know when deliveries are actually arriving?
What makes it worse is the constant misinformation. Every day it’s a different answer. I’ve wasted my time making unnecessary trips because I was given information that clearly wasn’t accurate.
If you can’t guarantee stock, fine — but don’t keep giving customers false expectations and sending them back to the store day after day. A simple “we don’t know when it’s coming” would have been more honest.
For a company of this size, this level of organisation and communication is completely unacceptable. I expected far better and will seriously think twice about relying on this store again.

I had an excellent experience bringing my cat, Opal, to this practice. She has always found vet visits extremely stressful, so I was quite anxious about how she would cope. It makes it stressful for me too - she's a biter and a swiper, and once bit the vet really hard (sorry).
From the moment we arrived, everyone was calm, kind and professional. The veterinary nurse was absolutely fantastic. She explained why she preferred using a towel rather than protective gauntlets, allowing her to handle Opal more gently and safely. Although Opal loudly voiced her opinions throughout, she was treated with such confidence, patience and kindness. All in all, and everything went far more smoothly than I had anticipated.
The vet was equally excellent. He took the time to discuss Opal's vaccination history, parasite treatment and the pros and cons of the feline leukaemia vaccine based on her lifestyle. I really appreciated his balanced, thoughtful advice, with no pressure to do anything unnecessary.
While I was waiting, I saw the team helping a worried new kitten owner. They were honest, informative and genuinely caring, reinforcing my impression that animal welfare is a priority with this practice.
I left feeling enormously relieved and much more confident about bringing Opal back in the future. Thank you so much to the whole team for making what I had expected to be a stressful visit such a positive experience. You're the best!

On Monday, 5th, I visited Pets at Home on Old Kent Road with my son to look at hamsters. Unfortunately, my interaction with a staff member named Beatrice was really disappointing. Despite my polite request, she was rude, unhelpful, and didn’t follow through with getting a manager as I asked. It left me feeling like I’d never want to return.

On the flip side, Billy was an absolute star. He not only helped us pick out the right hamster, but went above and beyond to ensure my son felt confident handling it. He even reassured us that the cage we’d ordered was perfect and gave us extra tips for care. Billy was calm, kind, and attentive—he’s exactly the kind of person who makes a customer’s day.

Please give Billy the recognition he deserves—and I strongly recommend Beatrice gets some customer service training. Thanks for listening!

I visited this store last Thursday just to browse, I haven’t shopped there for ages.
As soon as I arrived I received a very warm greeting from the young lady (pink hair), which made me feel very welcome.
Even though she was attending to another customer she still took the time to acknowledge me.
I asked her where the cat section was and she showed me where it was.
After that, I wondered if my kitten which I brought in 7 years ago was still registered with the Veterinary side.
So I’d made my way towards the veterinary side and then decided against it due to the fact that it was quite busy.
I decided to make my way to the cat section to get some treats for my cat.
As I was browsing through the section I noticed that I was being tracked by security.
At first glance, it appeared to be an Asian/ Middle Eastern security guard who appeared to follow me around.
I chose to ignore him and continued with my shopping.
Then another security guard African / Caribbean, took over and continued to track me during my shopping and up to the point of me making my purchases.
At this point, I decided I had had enough of the harassment of this security guard and asked to speak to the manager about my experience.
When the duty manager arrived, I noticed she was the same lady who attended to me when I brought my kitten into the store in 2019.
As you can imagine was so relieved.
As I explained to her what happened to me in the store, the same security guard started walking past us while we were talking about what happened.
As if he was trying to make some sort of point!!
Not only did it make me feel very uncomfortable and demoralised by this incompetent bully on a power trip.
I was horrified by the level of disrespect he demonstrated towards me a customer and the female duty manager who was trying to apologise for this man’s conduct.
And that’s why I gave only 4 stars.
As a female shopping alone, I felt the behaviour of the security guard extremely creepy.
